title: Verifier behavior on malformed input
statement: Let $x$ and $u$ be binary words, and suppose the exact-consumption parser fails on $x$. Then the non-tautology verifier computes the one-bit output $1$ on the pair encoding of $x$ and $u$ within $2|x|+3$ steps.
replaced:
Let $x$ be a binary string on which the exact-consumption formula parser fails, and
let $u$ be any binary word. Then the non-tautology verifier, run on
$\mathrm{pair}(x, u)$, halts within $2|x| + 3$ steps with output the single bit $1$.
